== Title ==
<span lang="ja">戦術支援部隊</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">1フォース失って自分のリザーブデッキから最大3枚の兵員／トルーパーを探し出し、手札に入れる。その後リザーブデッキはシャッフルし、カットしてもとの所に置く。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">高度な訓練を受けた帝国軍の歩兵部隊は驚異的な速度で進軍し、敵の不意をついて一方的に攻撃することができる。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Tactical Support.

'''Lore''' — Highly trained Imperial infantry units can advance at astonishing speed and attack one-sidedly by catching the enemy off guard.

'''Game text''' — Lose 1 Force to search your Reserve Deck for up to 3 personnel or troopers and take them into hand. Then shuffle and cut the Reserve Deck and return it to its place.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The printed title is Tactical Support Unit (戦術支援部隊). It searches for 兵員／トルーパー. Lore says highly trained units that attack one-sidedly, not highly organized units that put foes on the defensive.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-tacticalsupport.gif|Original English face]], [[Tactical Support]].</ref>
